responsibility: This header declares GCC’s tree debugging and printing interface. It exposes raw and hook-based debug entry points for tree nodes and vectors, dump_addr and indent helpers, full and brief node printers, and print_decl_identifier with flag-controlled origin/name formatting. It is the public declaration layer for tree dump and debugging support implemented in print-tree.cc.
same_name_distinction: Provides declarations for tree debug/printing entry points, helpers, and PRINT_DECL_* flags; the concrete tree-formatting and traversal code is in print-tree.cc.
